raw.description:
Chip Software Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Chip Software Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $80,000–$100,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Chip Software Engineer to design and build software tooling, firmware, and infrastructure that support semiconductor design, verification, manufacturing, and post-silicon validation. In this role you will partner with hardware engineers and EDA teams to build software that accelerates silicon development cycles and improves yield, performance, and quality. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with practical experience working alongside hardware teams in EDA, verification, or post-silicon environments. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The starting salary range posted for this position is $263,900.00 to $359,500.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
Cloud / Network / Cybersecurity Engineer – Infrastructure & Security | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Cloud / Network / Cybersecurity Engineer to support and maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing technology infrastructure.

Depending on your background and specialization, this role may focus on cloud engineering, network infrastructure, cybersecurity, DevOps, systems administration, or a combination of these areas.

You’ll help configure and monitor infrastructure, troubleshoot complex technical issues, manage access and authentication, support security operations, and contribute to infrastructure deployments and upgrades.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with a practical understanding of networking, cloud environments, systems, and security best practices.

What You’ll Own

Cloud & Infrastructure Management

  • Configure, monitor, and maintain cloud and infrastructure environments
  • Support platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, or related technologies
  • Monitor infrastructure health, availability, and performance
  • Assist with infrastructure deployments, upgrades, and configuration changes
  • Help maintain reliable and scalable technical environments

Network Engineering & Troubleshooting

  • Configure and support network environments
  • Troubleshoot network, connectivity, DNS, routing, and infrastructure issues
  • Diagnose complex technical problems across systems and environments
  • Monitor network health and performance
  • Help maintain reliable connectivity across business systems

Cybersecurity & Security Operations

  • Implement and maintain security best practices
  • Monitor systems for potential security issues
  • Support security-related troubleshooting and incident response
  • Help identify infrastructure vulnerabilities and operational risks
  • Collaborate with relevant teams to improve the organization’s security posture

Identity & Access Management

  • Manage user access, permissions, and authentication
  • Support appropriate access controls across systems and platforms
  • Troubleshoot authentication and authorization issues
  • Help maintain secure access practices
  • Assist with onboarding, offboarding, and access changes when required

Monitoring & Incident Response

  • Monitor systems for performance, availability, and security issues
  • Investigate alerts and technical incidents
  • Support incident response and troubleshooting
  • Identify root causes and help implement corrective actions
  • Escalate critical infrastructure or security issues appropriately

Infrastructure Automation

  • Identify repetitive infrastructure tasks that can be automated
  • Build or support automation for routine technical processes
  • Improve consistency and efficiency across infrastructure workflows
  • Reduce unnecessary manual administration where possible

Documentation & Technical Operations

  • Maintain clear technical documentation
  • Document infrastructure configurations, processes, and troubleshooting procedures
  • Keep operational and security documentation current
  • Support repeatable processes for deployments, incidents, and system changes

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with engineering, IT, security, and business teams
  • Support technical projects and infrastructure initiatives
  • Communicate technical issues clearly to relevant stakeholders
  • Help coordinate deployments, upgrades, and operational changes

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in network engineering, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, systems administration, or a related infrastructure role
  • Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, and/or enterprise networking technologies
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts and security best practices
  • Experience troubleshooting complex technical and connectivity issues
  • Understanding of user access, permissions, and authentication
  • Experience monitoring infrastructure, networks, or systems
  • Strong technical documentation skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Professional working English
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Relevant technical certifications
  • Cloud certifications related to AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Networking or cybersecurity certifications
  • Experience with infrastructure or task automation
  • Experience supporting incident response
  • Experience with identity and access management
  • Familiarity with DevOps and deployment workflows
  • Experience supporting distributed or cloud-based environments

Tools & Technologies

AWS | Microsoft Azure | Google Cloud Platform (GCP) | Enterprise Networking | Identity & Access Management | Infrastructure Monitoring | Security Tools | DevOps & Automation Technologies

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Can troubleshoot complex technical problems methodically
  • Understand how networks, systems, cloud infrastructure, and security interact
  • Think about security as part of everyday infrastructure operations
  • Stay calm and organized when responding to technical incidents
  • Look for opportunities to automate repetitive work
  • Maintain clear documentation rather than relying on tribal knowledge
  • Communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Take ownership of problems through resolution

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include reviewing infrastructure and security alerts, troubleshooting a connectivity issue, managing user permissions, supporting a cloud deployment, or investigating a technical incident.

You may also update infrastructure configurations, automate repetitive tasks, document technical processes, and collaborate with engineering or IT teams on deployments and upgrades.

In short: you help keep the organization’s infrastructure secure, reliable, accessible, and running smoothly.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Infrastructure availability and reliability
  • Network and system performance
  • Speed and effectiveness of technical issue resolution
  • Security and access-control compliance
  • Successful infrastructure deployments and upgrades
  • Effective incident response
  • Reduction in repetitive manual infrastructure work
  • Accuracy and completeness of technical documentation

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Infrastructure / Technical Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience in cloud infrastructure, network engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, or systems administration and enjoy solving complex infrastructure and security challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing technology environments.

As a member of the Diversified Markets (DM) business unit, the Senior Industry Executive will lead strategic sales efforts within mid - sized and large telecommunications and utility accounts, driving new business growth while partnering across leadership and cross-functional teams to deliver client-focused solutions. Success comes from serving as a trusted advisor, maintaining forecast accuracy, growing a strong pipeline, and strengthening TransUnion’s reputation in the market. This role will report directly to Sales Vice President.This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.

  • Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans, prioritizing high-potential prospects and target accounts.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through presentation, negotiation, and close, with a focus on delivering customer value and ROI.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including market development, subject matter experts, pre-sales engineers, and account managers to advance opportunities and drive results.

Required Knowledge and Experiences

raw.description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 550 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000
artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE TEAM

We are seeking candidates to join our Personalization team. This team is responsible for developing recommendation system that improve experience for millions of fans daily by helping them to navigate through thousands of artists playing in the area. We improve ticket purchase experience for hundreds of millions of live event fans by using real time streaming combined with various AWS technologies. If you are a passionate technologist who can get a lot done while having fun, come join a team of like-minded, skilled professionals where you can learn and share your knowledge!

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO

  • Work with Data Scientists and Engineers to introduce new features, new models, and new techniques to improve the Live Nation and Ticketmaster recommendation platform

  • Write clean, well-designed, testable, and efficient code

  • Contribute to all phases of the application development life cycle

  • Build out and support all the necessary infrastructure in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS)

  • Maintain and evolve existing real-time processing systems

  • Identify bottlenecks and bugs as well as propose solutions to identified problems

  • Ensure overall system health through automated testing and monitoring

  • Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to provide efficient automated processes

  • Integrate with 3rd-party applications and vendors

  • Support continuous improvement by investigating alternative approaches to existing solutions

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or related field

  • Mid-level engineer with strong knowledge of Python

  • 5+ years of experience developing software using Java/Python or similar high-level language

  • Experience in development of highly available and reliable distributed systems

  • Familiarity with AWS stack (EC2, S3, Elastic Beanstalk, AWS Lambda)

  • Experience working with containerized applications

  • Experience with Kafka and Kafka Streams

  • Data Engineering skills (ETL)

  • PySpark and PyTorch or similar a bonus

  • Effective visual and verbal communication skills

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process. Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

HIRING PRACTICES
The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

raw.description:
At WelbeHealth, we serve our communities’ most vulnerable seniors through shared intention, pioneering spirit, and the courage to love. These core values and our participant-focus lead the way no matter what.

The Tax Strategy & Planning Manager is accountable for leading WelbeHealth’s tax compliance, planning, and strategic tax initiatives. This role ensures compliance with federal, state, and local tax requirements while focusing on identifying and implementing tax-efficient strategies that support the organization’s long-term growth, expansion into new markets, and evolving healthcare delivery models. Reporting directly to the Controller and working closely with the CFO, this role will play a key part in evaluating tax implications of strategic initiatives including new market entry, entity structuring, partnerships, joint ventures, and potential acquisitions.

This role is different because the Tax Strategy & Planning Manager at WelbeHealth:

  • Serves as a strategic advisor to executive leadership by evaluating the tax implications of organizational growth initiatives, new market expansion, entity structuring, and evolving healthcare operations
  • Leads complex, cross-functional tax planning efforts that directly support scalable growth, operational efficiency, and long-term financial strategy within a rapidly growing healthcare organization

We care about our team members. That’s why we offer:

  • Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days
  • 401K savings + match
  • Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus
  • And additional benefits!

On the day-to-day, you will:

  • Manage federal, state, and local tax compliance including income, franchise, sales/use, property, and other applicable filings, as well as monitor evolving federal and state tax regulations affecting healthcare and PACE organizations
  • Coordinate preparation and review of tax returns with external tax advisors and ensure timely and accurate filings
  • Identify and implement tax-efficient strategies that support the organization’s operational and financial objectives
  • Evaluate tax impacts of new market expansion, operational changes, and reimbursement structures, as well as develop forward-looking tax planning strategies that align with the organization’s growth strategy
  • Provide tax analysis and structuring support for acquisitions, joint ventures, partnerships, and other strategic transactions
  • Partner with legal, finance, and executive leadership on entity structuring, organizational design, and evaluating tax considerations for new states, markets, and program structures
  • Translate complex tax matters into practical guidance for business stakeholders, as well as support strategic finance initiatives in partnership with the Controller and CFO

Job requirements include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or taxation; master’s in taxation preferred; CPA preferred
  • Seven (7) to ten (10) years of tax experience in public accounting, healthcare, or corporate tax
  • Strong experience with multi-state taxation and complex entity structures
  • Experience supporting tax planning, structuring, or transaction-related initiatives
  • Public company experience strongly preferred
  • Healthcare, managed care, nonprofit, or provider organization experience highly preferred
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel; familiarity with data query/data management tools (Access, SQL, Business Objects)

We are seeking a Tax Strategy & Planning Manager who is analytical, strategic, and passionate about building scalable tax strategies that support organizational growth and operational excellence. The ideal candidate combines deep technical tax expertise with a collaborative, business-minded approach, and is excited to navigate complex healthcare and multi-state tax environments while partnering closely with executive leadership. If you are ready to play a key role in shaping strategic financial initiatives that support our long-term growth, we’d love to hear from you!

Compensation consists of base salary plus bonus. WelbeHealth offers a competitive total rewards package that includes a 401(k) match, comprehensive healthcare coverage, and a broad range of additional benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience and relevant qualifications.

At WelbeHealth, we embrace and cherish the diversity of our team members, and we're committed to building a culture of inclusion and belonging. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
